Of course, for some people and subs, this is most CERTAINLY not ideal, so I propose a third option, Semi-anonymous mode. What this mode would allow you to do is have a checkbox in the submit post screen to post as an anonymous user, and all of YOUR comments in that post are also given the same numerical identifier. Other users, however, could choose either to be anonymous or not within the comment section. I see this being applied to advice subverses, where users are often lost, and looking for assistance, but, at the same time are revealing large amounts of personal information that they likely don't want linked back to their account, hence the heavy use of throwaways back on the other site, but if these subs were to go full anon, they would loose the inter-user identification that is so valuable. For instance, lets take /v/legaladvice. While its mostly barren at the moment, back on the other site, it was quite large, and, if we get big here, it will no doubt rise itself.
